title: Properties of hypersurface singular sets of solutions to the $σ_k$-Yamabe equation in the negative cone
summary: We consider conformally flat Lipschitz viscosity solutions to the $σ_k$-Yamabe equation in the negative cone which admit smooth hypersurface singularities. Under natural regularity assumptions (that are satisfied by solutions to the $σ_k$-Loewner-Nirenberg problem on annuli, for example), we first prove that the trace and normal derivatives of such a solution along the hypersurface satisfy a certain PDE.
